name: Seymour
desc: Prototype 4ACV07 is a mechanical dog created by Alain Guillotin to protect his sister Mary-Ann Guillotin during her service in the Marechaussee Phantom.

value.name: Seymour
value.desc:
Seymour

"Welcome back, milady. You are as gentle, lovely, and radiant as ever."

customize.text:
<color=#ffd780>March 14, 2025</color>
"Hey, long time no see, Seymour! Hehe, time to test if you've gotten any cool upgrades... Paimon would like to have some Rainbow Macarons, Conch Madeleine, Bulle Souffle, and..."
"It is a pleasure to meet you again, Ms. Paimon.
Negative. The performance of Prototype 4ACV07 has shown no observable significant improvement during the less-than-470 clockwork cycles that marked our brief separation. However, I have received and fully comprehended your instructions. Please continue imagining that you have Rainbow Macarons, Conch Madeleine, and Bulle Souffle. I will not disturb you.
Emotional fluctuation detected in Ms. Paimon. Would you like to terminate the food imagination sequence?"
"Ugh! The cheek of him! And he doesn't even have cheeks! Mamere, look at— Wait, why's everyone laughing!? Is Seymour messing with Paimon on purpose?"

The prototype 4ACV07 was created by Alain Guillotin around 500 years ago to protect and escort Alain's sister, Mary-Ann Guillotin, during Marechaussee Phantom duty. Despite the lack of supporting evidence, Seymour is thought to be the first thinking machine that Alain ever made. Seymour's creation was inspired by Alain's assistant and friend, Carter Scherbius, who proposed to create a thinking Kamera. He believed that Alain would regret those moments when he was not with his sister Mary-Ann and would want to see how she grew up and changed. Alain did not initially approve of the idea, but he still saw the benefit of such a development for the Maison Gardiennage.

More than "(1/7)×10^21 clockwork cycles" ago, Marechaussee Hunters tracked down the radical organization Narzissenkreuz Ordo, which was about to revive the monster of the Abyss Elynas through the ritual. Elynas appeared in Fontaine during the Cataclysm 500 years ago and could have destroyed the whole region. When Alain Guillotin found out about the upcoming ritual, he sent Seymour to inform the Iudex of Fontaine Neuvillette about it. A battle between the Marechaussee Hunters, including Mary-Ann Guillotin and Seymour, and the Narzissenkreuz Ordo occurred inside Elynas's body. During the battle, an explosion killed many agents of the Marechaussee Phantom and their Meks. Due to the explosion, Seymour was significantly damaged and went into hibernation mode.
From the wounds Elynas received from the explosion, new creatures called Melusines were born. Each Melusine was born with a shard of broken Meks, so they began to consider these objects as their "tokens" that must be protected. Seymour’s artificed clockwork relay module was obtained by Melusine Mamere, an artist who later found Seymour among the wreckage, repaired it, and became its friend.

For many years, while Seymour's functions were in hibernation, he could communicate with Mamere using pre-configured automated responses since she had his artificial clockwork relay module. He had 103,900 artistic styles stored in his memory, but none were similar to Mamere's style, so he considered her paintings to be unique and of great artistic value. One day, Jakob Ingold tried to take Mamere's special paints from her, which, unbeknownst to her, were the clots of crystallized blood of Elynas. During the clash, Seymour was damaged, and the Traveler and Paimon went to collect special parts to repair Seymour. Under the instructions of her Father, Elynas, whom only Mamere could hear, she restored Seymour's work, and he came out of hibernation. After waking up, he remembered his main goal: to accompany his master, Mary-Ann, and ensure she would smile happily. Due to memory damage, he did not remember where Mary-Ann was, so he said goodbye to Mamere and went to look for his master.

=Teaming up with the Traveler, Oceanid Ann, and a former member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, Caterpillar, Seymour set out to find Mary-Ann. During their adventure, it turned out that Mary-Ann Guillotin, Seymour's master, almost died during the Battle in Elynas when Seymour was damaged. Mary-Ann's consciousness was absorbed by the Oceanid Lyris, a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, and from this merge, the Oceanid Mary-Ann of Annapausis was born. When Seymour finally met Mary-Ann, she told him that his task of protecting his master was complete and that now he could live as he wanted. Seymour chose to return to Melusine Mamere and invite her to travel with him, Ann, and Mary-Ann. Mamere happily agreed, promising to meet the Traveler soon and leaving a painting of her, Seymour, Paimon, and the Traveler as a gift.

customize.name: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo
customize.desc: The Narzissenkreuz Ordo is the secret society formed by Rene de Petrichor and Jakob Ingold to create Neohumans in order to survive against the destruction of the world as foretold by the world-formula. It was declared an illegal extremist group and a criminal organization by Fontainian law under Iudex Neuvillette.

customize.name: Melusines
customize.desc: Melusines are an all-female species born from the wounds of Elynas after he was injured from an explosion that took place within his petrified body. They once resided exclusively in Merusea Village, but after meeting the newly appointed Iudex Neuvillette, many can now be found on the surface of Fontaine as part of the Marechaussee Phantom.

One of the earliest new-type clockwork meka to be made.

It is said that during his time at the Institute of Natural Philosophy, the Lord-Artificer Guillotin created machines that could simulate genuine intelligence.
